generate_dummy_code_pybind11: generate C++ source code with pybind11 bindings for a given number of dummy classes
generate_dummy_code_boost: generate C++ source code with Boost.Python bindings for a given number of dummy classes
benchmark_pybind11_compilation: run the benchmark script to measure pybind11 compilation time and output size across scales
benchmark_boost_compilation: run the benchmark script to measure Boost.Python compilation time and output size across scales
summarize_benchmark_script: summarize the benchmark script that compares pybind11 and Boost.Python compilation performance
